# Introduction
This script handles the data visualization for the outputs generated in the `1DP_02_astro_subset` R Markdown file.

```{r}
suppressMessages(library("Matrix"))
suppressMessages(library("DropletUtils"))
suppressMessages(library("ggplot2"))
suppressMessages(library("Seurat"))
suppressMessages(library("SeuratObject"))
suppressMessages(library("clustree"))
suppressMessages(library("DoubletFinder"))
suppressMessages(library("scProportionTest"))
suppressMessages(library("gridExtra"))
suppressMessages(library("dittoSeq"))

suppressMessages(library("future"))
suppressMessages(library("patchwork"))

plots <- list()
col_list <- list()
orders <- list()
source("code/0F_01_colours_orders.R", local = F, echo = F, print.eval = F)
source("code/0F_02_general_functions.R", local = F, echo = F, print.eval = F)
source("code/0F_03_label_names.R", local = F, echo = F, print.eval = F)
gene_symbol <- read.table("data/all_genes.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
```


Create folders for saving objects
```{r Folders, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define folders
folders <- c("results", "results/06_technical_parameters")

# Create folders if they don't exist
lapply(folders, function(f) if (!dir.exists(f)) dir.create(f, recursive = TRUE))
```


#Violin plots for astro cells 
```{r}
#seurat_object <- readRDS("ws/02_astro_subset/1DP_02_seurat_annotated_astro.rds")

meta_data <- seurat_object@meta.data

# Generate plots without condition faceting
p1 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "nFeature_RNA", get_label("nFeature_RNA")) + 
  scale_y_log10(labels = add_sci_superscript) +
  violin_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

p2 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "nCount_RNA", get_label("nCount_RNA")) + 
  scale_y_log10(labels = add_sci_superscript) +
  violin_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

p3 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "percent.mt", get_label("percent.mt")) + 
  violin_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

p4 <- violin_boxplot(meta_data, "percent.rib", get_label("percent.rib")) + 
  violin_theme

# Combine vertically using patchwork
library(patchwork)
plots[["violin"]] <- p1 / p2 / p3 / p4
plots[["violin"]]

ggsave(
  filename = "results/06_technical_parameters/2V_06_violinplot_astro_isol_astro.tiff",             
  plot = plots[["violin"]],         
  device = "tiff",                          
  width = 5,                              
  height = 11,                              
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600,            
  compression = "lzw",  
  bg = "white" 
)
```

```{r}

# Calculate medians grouped by Isolation protocol and Condition
median_by_isolation <- meta_data %>%
  group_by(Isolation_pub) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_nFeature    = median(nFeature_RNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_nCount      = median(nCount_RNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_percent_mt  = median(percent.mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_percent_rib = median(percent.rib, na.rm = TRUE),
    Cell_Count         = n(), # Optional: shows how many cells are in this group
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View the results
print(median_by_isolation)
```
